Services

As a consultant, designer, and instructor, I specialize in helping research teams and businesses effectively harness data, build models and decision tools, and communicate insights through engaging stories and visuals.

With or without AI agents, I continue to code daily, mostly in R, Python, JavaScript and D3.js. Check out my portfolio and full bio for contact details.

Geospatial and Remote Sensing Analysis

Machine learning model development and inference for geospatial applications

I offer services in developing predictive models for geospatial applications. Including, but not limited to, retrieval models for multi- and hyperspectral satellite and airborne sensors, as well as multivariate prediction models for ecosystem assessment and climate projections.

Software Development

Software development, data pipelines & cloud infrastructure for scalable geo-applications. Tailored software development and implementation services for the efficient processing and analysis of large-scale geospatial and remote sensing datasets.
